criteria: All30 hubs have explicit trial community population, workforce, harvest, food, workshop and material ledgers; unknown ownership creates no lord, cash or disposal authority
House treasury is separate from private money and merchants, with local budget/funding control and actual local quote, receipt and payment conservation

Local NPC heads and explicitly scoped delegates procure only needed rice/timber within free stock, real house funds, monthly budget and protected reservations; player agency, absence, expiry and physical revocation preserved
Delegate reports include immutable dated house cash/material/budget observations only after physical delivery/opening; no remote live balances or copied-report refresh

Normal entry and local UI, legacy v8 bytes, actual generation recovery/future equality across nationwide production, funding, purchase, material shortage and revocation; Game build/headless Node3D; preserve causal validation while avoiding redundant full regional replay
target_meaning: Nationwide trial ledgers, local house procurement and dated stewardship observations. No verified historical demographics, invented ownership, offsite shopping/teleport logistics, national war AI, mandatory player actions or asset changes.
